threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals a shared-services user's session and takes over the mailbox and single sign-on, reaching data of all four entities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant; no conditional access for unmanaged devices; sign-in logs kept 30 days and not reviewed
existing_controls: SSO with push MFA and number matching; EDR on endpoints
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators, finance, treasury, HR, and Finance staff; conditional access requiring managed devices; token-theft and impossible-travel alerts

threat_event: Business email compromise changes a vendor's bank details in the ERP and redirects a payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor bank-detail changes accepted by email without an independent callback (gap 12)
existing_controls: ERP segregation between vendor master changes and payment release; bank dual approval
treatment_plan: Callback to a number already on file for every bank-detail change; second approver; hold first payment to a changed account for 5 business days; targeted training for payables staff

threat_event: Attacker or insider abuses one of 7 global administrator accounts (including 2 MSP accounts) to take over the shared identity tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Too many standing global administrators; push MFA on admin accounts; no alerting on admin role use
existing_controls: Administrator accounts are named; MFA required
treatment_plan: Reduce standing global administrators to 2 plus 2 break-glass accounts; hardware security keys; time-limited elevation for MSP staff; alert on every admin role activation

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts cloud tenant workloads and endpoints and deletes the backups kept in the same account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups share the production account, region, and administrator roles; no restore test; EDR alerts not watched after hours
existing_controls: EDR on endpoints; daily backups; automatic patching
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore tests; 24x7 managed detection and response

threat_event: Email and files are deleted by an attacker or an administrator error and cannot be recovered
threat_source: Privileged user error, or an attacker with administrator rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent backup of the productivity suite beyond the provider's short retention
existing_controls: Provider recycle bin and version history
treatment_plan: Third-party backup of mail, files, and chat with 1-year retention in a separate account

threat_event: Employees across the group open Finance loan documents through an all-employee collaboration site or the AI assistant
threat_source: Curious or careless employee; AI assistant retrieval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 41 sites grant all-employee access, including Finance's loan-documents archive (gap 5)
existing_controls: All-employee access removed from the loan archive on 2026-08-13
treatment_plan: Quarterly permission review of all sites; sensitivity labels on Finance and HR sites; block external and all-employee sharing on restricted sites

threat_event: An intrusion into the shared platform goes undetected because logs are not collected, reviewed, or kept
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No central log collection; identity and email audit logs kept 30 days; nobody reviews them (gap 6)
existing_controls: Provider default logging
treatment_plan: Log workspace with 1-year retention; weekly review of sign-in and admin activity; alert rules for risky sign-ins

threat_event: An attack that starts at night or on a weekend runs unchecked until the next business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDR alerts are monitored only in business hours (gap 7)
existing_controls: EDR blocks known malware automatically
treatment_plan: Contract 24x7 managed detection and response with authority to isolate hosts

threat_event: A former subsidiary employee signs in with an account that was not disabled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations reach shared IT by email about 3 business days late; SYS-11 uses local accounts outside SSO (gap 11)
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day disable triggered from the HRIS termination record; SYS-11 moved to SSO; monthly account reconciliation across all SaaS

threat_event: Customer information is exported in bulk from the loan servicing system through a compromised Finance user session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Loan servicing system allows bulk export for all Finance users; no alert on large exports
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; role-based access in the servicing system
treatment_plan: Limit export rights to 2 roles; vendor export alerts to the Qualified Individual; conditional access for SYS-12

threat_event: ACH collection files holding consumer bank account numbers are stolen from the file transfer server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files kept indefinitely with no retention schedule; any IT administrator can read them (gap 14)
existing_controls: Provider disk encryption; SFTP access limited to the bank's addresses
treatment_plan: Delete files 90 days after settlement; encrypt files with a customer-managed key; restrict read access to the Treasury and Payments Analyst and one administrator

threat_event: A known vulnerability in a site firewall or cloud workload is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning or penetration testing; Home Services firewall firmware two major versions behind (gap 13)
existing_controls: Automatic patching on endpoints; MSP patches servers
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; annual external and internal penetration test; firewall firmware brought current

threat_event: The MSP's remote management tools are compromised and used against every site and the tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP contract has no security requirements; MSP tools reach all endpoints (gap 10)
existing_controls: MSP technicians use named accounts
treatment_plan: Contract amendment with security terms and incident notice; MFA and source-address limits on MSP tools; annual MSP security review

threat_event: A breach or outage at the ERP or loan servicing vendor exposes group data, and the group relied on controls it never checked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC 2 reports received but never reviewed; complementary user entity controls not mapped (gap 10)
existing_controls: SOC 2 Type 2 reports on file
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review with CUEC mapping (P09); service provider inventory

threat_event: Material non-public acquisition information leaks from email, the board portal, or personal sharing links
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deal documents shared with anyone-with-the-link sharing; no named data room
existing_controls: Board portal requires SSO and MFA
treatment_plan: Named-access data room for each deal; disable anonymous links on deal sites; watermarking

threat_event: Stolen treasury credentials are used to send a fraudulent wire
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callback on new wire payees is informal; bank portal tokens are app-based
existing_controls: Bank-enforced dual approval; positive pay
treatment_plan: Bank hardware tokens for both approvers; documented callback for every new payee; dedicated browser profile for banking

threat_event: An attacker who takes over an employee's HRIS account redirects the employee's direct deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HRIS allows bank-detail changes without a waiting period or out-of-band notice
existing_controls: SSO with MFA on the HRIS
treatment_plan: Out-of-band notice to the employee on any bank change; 3-day verification hold

threat_event: Employee SSNs and benefits enrollment data leak from HRIS exports kept in email and shared files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll and benefits exports emailed between HR and the carrier broker; HR site not restricted
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; N55-R06 (enrollment information only; 45 CFR 164.530(k))
existing_controls: Email encrypted in transit between providers
treatment_plan: Stop emailing exports and use the HRIS's secure transfer to the broker; restrict the HR site; 1-year retention on exports

threat_event: The generative AI assistant returns restricted data (customer information, HR records, deal information) to users who should not see it
threat_source: AI assistant retrieval of over-shared content
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot launched without a data-access review; assistant inherits every permission a user has (gap 15)
existing_controls: Enterprise AI terms: prompts not used to train the provider's models
treatment_plan: Pause expansion; permission cleanup; exclude restricted sites from AI retrieval; approved-use rules in POL-05 (see P10)

threat_event: AI assistant output is used in a hiring, discipline, or credit decision without real human review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI use in employment or credit decisions before 2026-09-25
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 group profile GV.PO-01; ECOA and Regulation B adverse action duties (12 CFR 1002.9) for Finance
existing_controls: None before POL-05
treatment_plan: POL-05 prohibits AI in employment and credit decisions; training for HR and Finance staff

threat_event: A security event affecting Finance customer information is handled without a plan and misses the FTC and state notice deadlines
threat_source: Any security event (trigger) combined with process failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No group incident response plan; WISP incident section never tested; subsidiaries lack an escalation path (gap 9)
existing_controls: Cyber insurance breach hotline
treatment_plan: Group incident response policy and runbook (P06, P08); annual tabletop including all subsidiary Presidents

threat_event: Internet or network loss at the Supply warehouse stops order entry and shipping
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet circuit and single firewall at the warehouse
existing_controls: Paper pick tickets for will-call orders
treatment_plan: Cellular failover at the warehouse; spare firewall kept at HQ

threat_event: A hurricane closes HQ and the Home Services shop for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written contingency plan; some staff lack laptops; HQ holds the only file transfer workstation for bank files
existing_controls: SaaS systems reachable from anywhere; hurricane checklist for the shop
treatment_plan: Group contingency plan from the BIA (P05); laptops for all treasury and payroll roles; bank file transfer from any managed laptop

threat_event: A cloud ERP outage during month-end close or payroll week delays close and reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ERP instance; vendor-controlled recovery
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitment in SOC 2 system description
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CFO: vendor commitment meets the BIA (P05); lender reporting deadlines allow several days

threat_event: An error or unapproved change in the integration service corrupts subsidiary data feeding the consolidated financials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management; no automated reconciliation between subsidiary systems and the ERP
existing_controls: Monthly manual reconciliation by the Controller
treatment_plan: Change approval and testing for integration jobs; daily automated record-count and total reconciliation

threat_event: An undocumented change to identity, firewall, or cloud network settings opens unintended access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management or change log (gap noted in P07 CM-3)
existing_controls: Only 3 IT staff and the MSP can change settings
treatment_plan: Lightweight change log with CFO-approved standard changes; weekly review of configuration change alerts

threat_event: A lost or stolen technician tablet exposes consumer names, addresses, and service history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets carry cached SYS-11 data
existing_controls: Device PIN; remote wipe; device encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: data on tablets is not personal information under Fla. Stat. 501.171 without identifiers such as SSNs or account numbers; remote wipe tested

threat_event: A caller impersonating an employee gets the help desk to reset MFA and takes over the account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No identity verification procedure for MFA resets; MSP after-hours help desk can reset MFA
existing_controls: Help desk knows most employees by voice
treatment_plan: MFA reset only after a callback to the manager and a video check; MSP barred from MFA resets

threat_event: A Finance employee looks up or sells customer information without a business reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servicing system access reports are not reviewed
existing_controls: Role-based access in the servicing system
treatment_plan: Monthly access-report review by the Finance President; annual confidentiality acknowledgment

threat_event: Changes to the shared platform (new sites, new AI features, new vendors) create risks to Finance customer information that nobody assesses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Finance's written risk assessment not updated since 2023; 2025 Qualified Individual report not delivered (gap 3)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-13; Finance customer information
existing_controls: 2026 risk assessment (this register) and 2026 Qualified Individual report delivered 2026-09-25
treatment_plan: Annual risk assessment each August; change triggers in POL-01; Qualified Individual report each September

threat_event: The identity provider is unavailable or all administrators are locked out, and nobody can administer any system
threat_source: Provider outage, misconfiguration, or attacker lockout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No break-glass accounts; every system depends on SSO
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments
treatment_plan: Two break-glass accounts excluded from conditional access, stored sealed and offline, tested quarterly

threat_event: Staff at the Supply sales counter share one generic account, so actions cannot be traced and the password never changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared counter account on 3 warehouse desktops (found in P07 testing, 2026-09-10)
existing_controls: Desktops lock after 15 minutes
treatment_plan: Named accounts with fast user switching and badge-tap sign-in for counter staff
